fields.name: id
fields.description: hydrant identifier in the format WH-A99-999 where WH stands for Water Hydrant, A99 is the grid, and the first of the last three numbers is 0 for distribution or transmission subsystem, 1 for Dedicated Fire Protection, 8 for Musqueam owned, and 9 for a private hydrant.  The last two 9's are a sequence number.
fields.label: ID

fields.name: subsystem
fields.description: the subsystem where DSTR is distribution; TRNS is transmission; and DFPS is dedicated fire protection
fields.label: SUBSYSTEM

fields.name: code
fields.description: is the manufacturer
fields.label: CODE

fields.name: covwaterhydrantunittype
fields.description: hydrant model
fields.label: COVWATERHYDRANTUNITTYPE

fields.name: distancefromcorner
fields.description: distance in meters to the nearest street corner
fields.label: DISTANCEFROMCORNER

fields.name: feederlen
fields.description: distance in meters from the hydrant to the hydrant control valve
fields.label: FEEDERLEN

fields.name: dir
fields.description: direction of hydrant lateral
fields.label: DIR

fields.name: line
fields.description: direction of hydrant lateral
fields.label: LINE

fields.name: color
fields.description: Red indicates < 500 Imperial Gallons Per Minute (GPM); Yellow indicates 500 - 1000 IMPERIAL GPM; Green indicates 1000 - 1500 IMPERIAL GPM; Blue indicates > 1500 IMPERIAL GPM; White indicates a PRIVATE HYDRANT
fields.label: COLOR

fields.name: incomm
fields.description: in commission yes or no
fields.label: INCOMM

fields.name: chr0
fields.description: contains no data
fields.label: CHR0

fields.name: chr1
fields.description: contains no data
fields.label: CHR1

fields.name: street_number
fields.description: Number assigned to the street where the hydrant is located
fields.label: STREET_NUMBER

fields.name: street
fields.description: location plus address or intersection. For example WS 123 Madeup Street means west side in front of 123 Madeup Street; if an intersection it will be the corner and the street and cross street for example NEC Madeup Street & Madeup Drive which means north east corner on Madeup Street where the cross street is Madeup Drive
fields.label: STREET

fields.name: oldhydnum
fields.description: old hydrant number
fields.label: OLDHYDNUM

fields.name: castsub
fields.description: sub designation for example Stanley Park
fields.label: CASTSUB

fields.name: oocdate
fields.description: last out of commission date
fields.label: OOCDATE

fields.name: oocnotes
fields.description: last out of commission notes
fields.label: OOCNOTES

fields.name: instdate1
fields.description: date hydrant was installed
fields.label: INSTDATE1

fields.name: oracleid
fields.description: identifier in Oracle database
fields.label: ORACLEID

fields.name: active
fields.description: all hydrants in this dataset are in service
fields.label: ACTIVE

fields.name: remarks
fields.description: any special notes
fields.label: REMARKS

fields.name: fireuseonly
fields.description: a 'Y' (yes) means not available for special use due to a special condition such as releasing water from the hydrant will set off fire alarms at nearby schools, etc.
fields.label: FIREUSEONLY

fields.name: status
fields.description: all hydrants in this dataset are in service
fields.label: STATUS

fields.name: compression
fields.description:
'Yes' means this is a compression valve type hydrant
 'N' means a gate valve type hydrant
fields.label: COMPRESSION

fields.name: adddttm
fields.description: the date the hydrant was added to the database
fields.label: ADDDTTM

fields.name: addby
fields.description: the person or operation that added the hydrant
fields.label: ADDBY

fields.name: modby
fields.description: the last person/operation that modified the record
fields.label: MODBY

fields.name: feature_id
fields.description: GIS internal number
fields.label: FEATURE_ID

fields.name: unitid
fields.description: Infrastructure management internal number
fields.label: UNITID

fields.name: geom
fields.description: Spatial representation of feature
fields.label: Geom

fields.name: geo_local_area
fields.description:
The local area where the feature is found, derived from the feature's coordinates or address in the source system. The City has 22 local areas (also known as local planning areas).
For more details, see the Local area boundary data set.
fields.label: Geo Local Area

default.title: Water hydrants
default.description:
This data set includes all in service water (fire) hydrants on the Dedicated Fire Protection, Distribution, and Transmission water subsystems. Some hydrants maybe out of commission and this is indicated on the data set.

Data currency

The extract on this website is updated weekly.

Data accuracy

Data is accurate at the time of data extract to the best of record keeping ability.
